approved_copy.summary: WAFA reported at least 12 Palestinians injured in an Israeli drone strike in al-Maslakh, Khan Younis, on Friday.
Eight-year-old Yamen Hisham Yahya Saqr died Friday from injuries sustained when Israeli forces shot him Wednesday in Qizan Rashwan, south of Khan Younis, WAFA reported.
Two Palestinians suffered minor injuries when an Israeli helicopter struck an apartment in Sheikh Radwan early Friday, medical and local sources told Anadolu.
